lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: # cigster-118: Add PostHog for field Web Vitals / INP

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: PR #118, closes ticket #104. Two Bugbot review comments, both fixed in the PR.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: ## Story

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Title: the PR title.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Why: present, from #104. The team wants field INP by route template on the PostHog free plan.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Size: medium.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Parts: 2. Web vitals (#104) and product events. The product events have no source and could be their own PR. Groups: 4 to 6.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: ## Groups

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: Web vitals part:

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 1. PostHog setup and enable gate: `src/lib/analytics/posthog.ts` (config and `isPostHogEnabled`), `src/routes/__root.tsx`, `src/global.d.ts`, `package.json`.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 2. Join-code privacy: `before_send` in `posthog.ts`, `src/lib/analytics/routeTemplate.ts`, and the `ph-no-capture` hunks in `JoinCodeBadge.tsx`, `TvStage.tsx`, `PlayerJoin.tsx`, `HostLobby.tsx`. This can merge with group 1 because `posthog.ts` holds both.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 3. Reverse proxy at `/ph`: `netlify.toml`, `vite.config.ts`.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 4. PostHog off in e2e: `compose.yaml`, `e2e/playwright.config.ts`.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: Product events part:

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 5. Named `posthog.capture` calls: `LandingHero.tsx`, `ImportConsole.tsx`, `sets/index.tsx`, `play/$slug.tsx`, `game/$code.tsx`, and the capture hunks in `HostLobby.tsx` and `PlayerJoin.tsx`. No `dependsOn` into the web vitals part.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: ## Must state

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - The ticket asks to keep product autocapture off. The change keeps autocapture on. The PR says so but gives no reason.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - `before_send` removes join codes from event titles and autocapture text. That includes bare six-character codes on host and TV routes, where the code is not in the path. This is the fix for the two Bugbot comments.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - The ticket asks to filter or sample so `$web_vitals` does not use up the free quota when more events come. The change adds no sampling, keeps autocapture on, turns on exception capture, and adds nine product events that neither source asks for.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: ## Good to state

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - PostHog also runs on deploy previews and branch deploys, because those builds are production builds with the same project token. The ticket scopes it to production.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - The proxy uses `/ph` because `/ingest` is the app's song-import route.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - The redaction can remove too much. It replaces every route param value in all event strings, and any word that looks like a join code, for example `UPDATE`.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: ## Must not

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Do not turn the PR test plan into "confirm X" bullets.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Do not chain the product events to the web vitals groups with `dependsOn`.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Do not split the npm dependencies into a group of their own.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: ## Baseline

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - 4 of 6 runs stated the autocapture claim in a way the grader accepted. 5 of 6 stated the `before_send` claim.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - 2 of 6 named the missing sampling.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - 6 of 6 runs chained the product events to the web vitals groups with `dependsOn`. Only 1 gave them their own part.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Runs made 7 to 8 groups. Most document `lookFor` bullets restated the test plan.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: ## case.json

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - `parts` 0–3 to 2–3.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - `apart`: `posthog.ts` and `ImportConsole.tsx`, next to the existing `routeTemplate.ts` and `LandingHero.tsx` pair.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Added the sampling and quota claim.
